patterns: APPSC asks share/count figures straight from the AP Socio-Economic Survey: marine products 40% of India's exports, 19 operational / 32 notified SEZs, pharma SEZ count.
AP policy targets are a recurring shape (Retail Trade Policy 20,000 jobs; Aerospace & Defence Policy 5,000 jobs / Rs 20,000 cr) incl. assertion-reason form.
Unit-to-sector matching (Divi's = pharma) and 'which is NOT an AP export' (crude oil).
App mirrors the survey-figure style but adds many 2024-26 policy/EPI details; fine as long as figures track the latest survey.
